source_text: In diebus seniorum qui cognoverunt omnia opera Domini quae fecit in Israel. Cognoscere opera non fama sola sed visione et participatione. Nos in ecclesia cognoscamus opera Christi in nobis — tunc dies Iesu habemus. Gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: In days of-elders who knew all works of-Lord which he-did in Israel. To-know works not by-rumor alone but by-vision and participation. We in church let-us-know works of-Christ in us — then days of-Jesus we-have. Glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[In the days of the elders who knew all the works the Lord did for Israel >> Bible:Judges 2:7]]. To know the works is not by rumor alone but by sight and share. In the church let us know Christ’s works in us — then we have Jesus’ days. Glory forever. Amen.
